meta.title: IS Vietnam's Ba Na Hills WORTH IT? - Absolutely Everything You Need to Know!
meta.description:
In this video I share my adventure to Sunworld's Ba Na Hills! We look at most of the attractions including the famous Golden Bridge. 

Was it worth it? You decide!  

But if you're ever in Da Nang, I'd definitely recommend a visit!

0:00 Introduction
1:05 Journey to the Cable Car
2:28 The World's Longest Cable Car
3:36 The Central Area
5:54 The Alpine Coaster
7:02 Funfair Theme Castle
7:30 The Golden Bridge
10:02 Walking down to Le Jardin D'Amour
10:31 The Wine Bar
11:18 The Wine Cellar
12:06 The Maze
13:27 Lower Gardens and Outro

Thai subtitle translation provided by Sarinya Sookkam.

Song 'A Walk in Paris' by Onoychenkomusic - see his page here: https://pixabay.com/users/onoychenkomusic-24430395/

comments.author: @aperture147
comments.text:
Thanks for the video! There are some guide before visiting Bana:
- Prepare your health, bring a comfortable pair of shoes and bring as little belongings as possible, Bana is larger than you think and you will have to climb a lot.
- Plan the visit on sunny day, if you don't want to see nothing in the fog. I first visited Bana right at the cloudy day and it takes me another trip to see the true beauty of Bana.
- Even when the weather is nice, prepare a raincoat. Don't bring the umbrella, not very helpful because the wind in the highland is pretty strong, it could break the umbrella or make it useless.
